configuration.description: A tabletop explainer. A printed telescope image of the planet Beta Pictoris b; paper schematics of the star and planet; quote cards; a paper tuning dial that converts radio frequency into magnetic field strength; a bar chart comparing Earth, Jupiter and Beta Pictoris b; a timeline of earlier radio claims; and a closing sources sheet.
